page.notes: Running head at top right is blacked out by ink and cannot be read. Page number printed as "3o6", given as 306. "credite debēri" is doubtful: the word after "de" is only partly legible, and "debēri" is my reading [?]. The macron over "popūli" and the form "Ro-mani" are uncertain. The last word "in-fu-" runs over onto the next page; the final line is the hyphenated fragment at the bottom right. The head "Causæ constitutio." is italic and set apart, so it is a level 2 heading.
